item.title: Your Success: The Graduate & Professional Student Wellness Kickoff
item.dc:subject: Health and Wellness
Graduate/Professional Students
Student Wellness Center
Student Wellness
resources
Health and Wellness
Graduate and Professional Students
Wellbeing
Success
item.content:encoded:
Wellness Wednesday in partnership with OUAB. 

Whether you are stepping onto campus for your first semester of classes or settling into the home stretch of your dissertation or clinical rotations, navigating the graduate and professional school experience requires more than just academic grit. Join us for a high-impact "insider’s guide" to the resources that matter most in supporting your well-being. We are bringing vital offices—the Student Wellness Center, CCS, Student Advocacy, the Graduate Ombudsperson, and Student Life Disability Services—for a rapid-fire "5x5" session. Get the essential details on confidential conflict resolution, lab/field-based accommodations, and mental health support specifically designed for the OSU advanced-degree lifecycle. Come for the insider knowledge, stay for the lunch, and leave with your support network identified and mapped out.

Presenters: Student Wellness Center (SWC), Student Advocacy Center, Student Life Disability Services (SLDS), Counseling and Consultation Service (CCS), & Graduate and Professional Student Ombudsperson

Adrienne Wilson
wilson.2313@osu.edu

item.title: Recovery is Spoken Here
item.dc:subject: Health and Wellness
Faculty/Staff
Student Wellness Center
item.content:encoded:
The Office of Student Life Student Wellness Center's Collegiate Recovery Community (CRC), in partnership with the Higher Education Center for Alcohol and Drug Misuse Prevention and Recovery (HECAOD), is excited to offer our Recovery is Spoken Here (RISH) training geared towards faculty and staff members. We aim to foster an environment where students in or seeking recovery feel accepted by their peers, are empowered to live genuinely, feel comfortable asking for help, and are celebrated by the Ohio State community. By becoming a Recovery Ally, you declare to students seeking recovery that you embody these ideals.

This 2-hour training covers a high-level overview of addiction and recovery, addiction and recovery on campus, recovery-friendly language, how to connect students with the CRC, and ways to get involved as a Recovery Ally.

Adrienne Wilson
wilson.2313@osu.edu
614-292-4527Register Here

item.title: Guiding Students to Wellness
item.ev:location: Recreation and Physical Activity Center (RPAC) Dave Griner Room
item.dc:subject: Health and Wellness
Faculty/Staff
Student Wellness Center
item.content:encoded:
The Guiding Students to Wellness workshop is a 2-hour training designed for faculty, staff and graduate/professional students at The Ohio State University. Participants will learn to effectively guide students to wellness through Motivational Interviewing and best-referral practices. Participants will gain insights into Student Wellness Center programming and services, as well as tangible skills to help students access campus health and wellness resources.

Adrienne Wilson

item.title: The Chew: Meal Planning & Prep Made Simple
item.dc:subject: Health and Wellness
Graduate/Professional Students
Student Wellness Center
item.content:encoded:
Wellness Wednesday in partnership with OUAB

Feeling unsure about what to cook or how to safely prepare and store food? This presentation offers practical tips and tools to reduce cooking stress and boost your confidence in the kitchen. You'll learn foundational meal planning strategies to help you create balanced meals, along with along safe food handling and storage practices, whether you're cooking from scratch or assembling something on the fly. 

Presenter: Janele Bayless, Wellness Coordinator for Nutrition Coaching and Education, Student Wellness Center

https://swc.osu.edu/ 


Adrienne Wilson
wilson.2313@osu.edu
